statement: ∀ (z : ℂ), z ≠ I → z ≠ -I → DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => (w - 1) / (w ^ 2 + 1)) z
script:

# technique: test fallback (kernel-checked instances)
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicFunctions.rational_differentiableAt

CASES = [

    (['1', '(by norm_num [Complex.ext_iff])', '(by norm_num [Complex.ext_iff])'], 'exact DifferentiableAt.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (by norm_num [Complex.ext_iff, pow_two])', False),
    (['(2 * Complex.I)', '(by norm_num [Complex.ext_iff])', '(by norm_num [Complex.ext_iff])'], 'exact DifferentiableAt.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (by norm_num [Complex.ext_iff, pow_two])', False),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, proof, edge in CASES]
